biomes.name: rift rim S
biomes.notes: The S rim, the black rim (biomes/riftrim/PLAN.md section 3). Split from 'rift rim' 2026-10-23, with the west bend south of the w rift highland.

biomes.name: High Rift
biomes.notes: Propagating eastern tip of the Great Rift between Oidong Valley and Siphon Pits: Opaline Sinter Staircase, North Mirror Graben (Lake Verdigris & Lake Cinnabar), Dorsal Wedge median horst, South Fire-and-Ice Coulee, and The Singing Gjar.

biomes.name: rift rim N
biomes.notes: The N rim, the glass rim (biomes/riftrim/PLAN.md section 3). Split from 'rift rim' 2026-10-23; its west end follows the w rift highland's border.

biomes.name: godshearth
biomes.notes: A caldera cut into the Godthrone's south flank: floor 3.6-3.75 km, walls 3-4 km high, the hot lake (3,642 m) and the spillway south. Climate (the owner, 2026-11-09): cools with height, 6 C per km from a floor of +7 C (warm month 15 C, days 24 / nights +6; cold month -2 C, days +7 / nights -10, to -18 C in the cold-air pools on clear nights): Cwb on the floor, Dwb on the benches, Dwc and ET on the rim. Rain 750-925 mm, about 70% of it in the warm half as afternoon storms, so the nights and the winters are clear (the model holds annual rain only). biomes/godshearth/PLAN.md.

settlements.name: Erehwon
settlements.notes: Pearl of Xanadu, 20,000 on its mountain lake (LORE.md 6.13; settlements/xanadu, target erewhon). Moved 2026-11-11 with edit 5.1-512, which remade its lake as an Atitlan-like caldera (121 x 66 km at -520 m, three volcanoes set back from the south shore, four islands; the Pleasure Dome of the Bay on its own small isle, landforms.json). The old pin 800,1503 is under the new lake. 805,1516 is a south-shore bench (-497 m): the town climbs to -415 m, a 90 m grey cliff to the palace plateau at -305 m, the mountainside behind, between the west and middle volcanoes 14 and 20 px back.

settlements.name: Longsong
settlements.notes: The History Monks' monastery on the south bank of the Bīruk al-Ghaym (r105, about 550 m3/s, 112 m wide) where it runs west-north-west down the Oidong Valley: the rock 356 m south of the river's centre as the open world draws it, the Great Gate's bridge crossing it. Moved 2026-11-11 (the owner, openworld/PLAN-SETTLEMENTS.md answer 10: 'Move the pin onto the 550 m3/s river') from 1226,1626, 11.7 km south-east; settlements/longsong (its frame turned 28.6 degrees so the river runs along its x axis), openworld/oidong-highrift.

settlements.name: Qiblai
settlements.notes: Holy city of the Decree, ~12,000, under a council of abbots (kits/qiblai/PLAN.md; LORE.md 6.13). Moved 2026-11-11 (the owner: by a river, near plentiful resources) from 963,1566, 65 km from any river and without salt, 101 km to the cataracts of Nahr ash-Shalalat (~1,100 m3/s, the region's biggest river): flat ground for the 1.6 km mandala (37 m relief), rock salt, potash, rare earths, saltpeter, copper and oil within 30 km, farmland 40% (openworld/PLAN-SITES.md).

settlements.name: Strongbow
settlements.notes: A cliff arcology of the Ancients hung in the scarp between the Oidong Valley and the Vale of Xanadu, the cliff the valley's river leaves by as a cataract (3 km south of it): its top on the lip at about 1,400 m, where the valley road ends, its foot on the Xanadu floor about 3,100 m below, so its elevator is the way between the two. Moved 2026-11-11 (the owner: 'a cliff arcology set in the side of a cliff'; 'by qiblai'; then 'right on the xanadu-oidong border - the same cliff the cataract is on - so that it offers a real advantage to anyone using its elevator') from 1026,1594, by way of 1298,1647 and 1013,1585 the same day; openworld/oidong-highrift.

settlements.name: Strongwall
settlements.notes: Moved 2026-11-12 (the owner: to the copper site) from 914,1634 (a 3x3 pit on the model) 13 km south to flat ground at 754 m, Cfb, 6 km from the rich copper band (240) at the scarp foot.

caverns.name: NW Twin Caldera & Caravan Skylight Vault (Nafkh al-Dukhān)
caverns.notes: Main caravan lava-tube skylight hall at +4,240 m on the WSW flank of the NW Twin (+6,480 m peak, +5,980 m crater floor), where caravaneers dash 1.8 km between Tube Segment I and Tube Segment II (biomes/twins/PLAN.md).

caverns.name: Sacred River Alph Pressurized Subglacial Reservoir
caverns.notes: Subglacial meltwater cavern on Xanadu's NE ice wall where geothermal pressure drives the bursting chasm fountain at the head of the Sacred River Alph (biomes/xanadu/NOTES.md).

branches.name: Lasso ('The Last Water') Southern Pass Feeder Tube

caverns.name: Kverkfjoll / Erebus Blue-Ice Fumarole Vaults
caverns.notes: Subglacial ice caves at +5,420 m beneath the +5,880 m SE Twin summit (`erebustwin`, biomes/twins/PLAN.md): blue-lit glacier vaults with 88 C boiling geysers and hollow fumarolic ice chimneys.

caverns.name: Bitta ('Bitter Water') Lava-Tube Spring Mouth
caverns.notes: Distal lava-tube spring surfacing at the fan toe of Oasis #4 (Bitta / al-Bitar, biomes/catch/PLAN.md), discharging mineralized volcanic brackish water.

caverns.name: Lasso ('The Last Water') Sub-Fan Cistern
caverns.notes: Southern lava-tube spring surfacing at Oasis #5 (Lasso / Lastu, biomes/catch/PLAN.md), the last water before the 7.3 km pass toward Strongbow.
